structured_output.rationale: DOS 2/16/2025; claim submitted 6/7/2025 (~111 days later). Payer denied both lines CO-29 (timely filing expired) with N211 (no appeal right). Filing indicator CI (commercial). Only one submission on record (277CA accepted 6/9/2025). No evidence of earlier submission. CO = provider liability, not billable to patient.

root_cause.explanation: Claim filed ~111 days post-DOS; Keystone Commercial denied CO-29 indicating the contractual filing limit was exceeded. No earlier submission evidence in the artifacts.

next_action.detail: Write off. CO-29 is provider liability, not billable to patient. If an earlier clearinghouse acceptance report exists proving submission within the contract window, appeal disputing the receipt date — but no such proof is present in this case.

evidence.fact: Both lines denied CAS*CO*29 with MOA N211; $0 paid
DOS 2/16/2025; claim created 6/7/2025; filing indicator CI (commercial)
Single submission accepted (A2:20) on 6/9/2025; no earlier submission on record
Coverage active from 1/1/2024 (EB*1, DTP*356); patient was eligible on DOS — not an eligibility issue

citations.rule: Genuinely late, no exception → do_not_resubmit / write off (CO = provider liability, not billable)
CO on commercial is payer's assertion; CO-29 is never patient billable
